assumptions: Everything here is wiki-sourced (stellaris.paradoxwikis.com/Archaeological_site, captured 2026-08-30), not extracted from the game files. Spot-check the sites you build tooling on against your current patch.

Reward codes (art/mat/rsh/uni/inf) are multipliers of your empire's current output with a min-max clamp, expanded in section 2 from Template:Reward. 'Best reward' therefore shifts with game stage - do not treat the clamps as flat numbers.
Chapter difficulties are not reproduced here. The wiki's site tables give rewards per chapter but are inconsistent about listing per-chapter difficulty, unlike the astral rift tables.
A few site tables on the wiki are visibly incomplete (Repowered Complex chapters beyond 3; Ancient Capital Site chapter 6). Those rows are marked rather than guessed.
Site names are the wiki's display names. Some sites share a name with an astral rift or a system (Ruined World, Windswept Fates); match on the group as well as the name when joining datasets.
The 67% minor-artifact deposit chance and the 80/16/4 value split come from the mechanics section and are not restated per site.

Several sites gate a reward behind a fight (Kleptomaniac Rats -> Shard, The Broken Gates -> The Elder One, The Sentinels, Planetary Machinery). Those are listed as rewards but the reward is not guaranteed by excavation alone.
Migrated to v3 on 2026-09-26. Site reward lines carry reward CODES as prefixes (art1 / mat2 / rsh3), unlike rift lines which spell the payout out - the parser handles both.
The bulk currency here is minor artifacts (payout type 'artifacts'), not astral threads.

Eight site reward lines point at situations documented on OTHER wiki pages (Embodied Identity, Adaptive Evolution, Horrific Inverse Mass, Genetic Crossroads, the Remnant chain). The site's own reward is captured; what the referenced situation pays out is not.

The Broken Gates references a 'Horrific Inverse Mass' situation, but the Situations wiki page documents that name against the Automated Dreadnought guardian instead. Unverified - do not assume the two are the same thing.
Sites have no choice tree on the wiki, so every chapter's choices[] is empty and title is null.

reward_codes.meaning: 6x minor artifacts, clamped to 50 / 150 / 250 by game stage

mechanics: A site must be inside your borders (or reachable) and needs a scientist plus a science ship. Each excavation phase is 90 days; AI empires take twice as long.
Roll = d10 + scientist skill + bonuses + clues - chapter difficulty. Scientist skill is leader level plus trait modifiers, and the Curator Archaeology Lab technology adds to it.
14+ completes the chapter (75 XP). 11-13 gives 2 clues for the next phase (40 XP). 6-10 gives 1 clue (25 XP). 5 or less may fire a mishap event (10 XP).
On completion a site has a 67% chance to leave a minor artifacts deposit: 80% of the time value 1, 16% value 2, 4% value 3. The Antiquarian trait adds +5% deposit chance per level.

Mishap events (roll 5 or less) are flavoured per site type but mechanically identical: excavating scientist dies (-2 clues); team members die (-1 clue); danger avoided (+3 clues); pay 100 Energy for +3 clues or lose 2; scientist gains the Maimed trait.
